scripts.dev: pnpm run migrations:check && pnpm run types && wrangler dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.cli.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: pnpm run migrations:check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist && node scripts/check-worker-bundle.ts
